title: JSON::XS versions from 4.0_00 before 4.05 for Perl corrupt the incremental buffer length by chopping past its end in…
description: JSON::XS versions from 4.0_00 before 4.05 for Perl contain a vulnerability in the incremental parser where the buffer length is corrupted by reading past its end after parsing a top-level number. This can cause the buffer length to wrap due to improper handling in incr_skip, potentially leading to an out-of-memory condition that terminates the Perl process.
